scripts.setup: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && tsx scripts/setup.ts
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres mailpit && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm -r --parallel --filter "./apps/*" dev
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @sgm/api exec tsx --env-file-if-exists=../../.env src/cli.ts db migrate
scripts.db:rollback: pnpm --filter @sgm/api exec tsx --env-file-if-exists=../../.env src/cli.ts db rollback
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter @sgm/api exec tsx --env-file-if-exists=../../.env src/cli.ts db reset
scripts.jobs:trigger: pnpm --filter @sgm/api exec tsx --env-file-if-exists=../../.env src/cli.ts jobs trigger
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run build
